summary.zh-Hant: 凡爾賽和約生效：德國割讓領土，薩爾、但澤、梅梅爾交國際管理，什列斯威、上西里西亞等地待公投
summary.en: The Treaty of Versailles enters into force: German cessions; the Saar, Danzig and Memel under international administration; plebiscites to come

citations.evidenceNote: 對德和約 1920-01-10 下午 4 時 15 分在巴黎交存批准書後生效。
